title: Software Developer
description: Build and maintain software applications that solve user or business problems.
required_skills: Programming fundamentals; Python; Java; Git; problem solving
typical_tasks: Implement features; debug defects; review code
learning_topics: Programming fundamentals; data structures; version control; software testing
project_ideas: Create a command-line task manager; Build a small REST API
entry_level_guidance: Practice fundamentals and publish a clearly documented project.

title: Full-Stack Developer
description: Develop both the user-facing interface and server-side parts of web applications.
required_skills: JavaScript; HTML; CSS; web APIs; databases
interests: web development; user interfaces; backend systems
typical_tasks: Build web pages; connect APIs; manage application data
learning_topics: HTML and CSS; JavaScript; HTTP and APIs; database basics
project_ideas: Build a personal portfolio site; Create a CRUD web application
entry_level_guidance: Start with a small end-to-end application and explain its components.

title: Java Backend Developer
description: Design server-side services and APIs using Java and related backend tools.
required_skills: Java; object-oriented programming; SQL; REST APIs
interests: backend development; problem solving; system design
typical_tasks: Implement API endpoints; validate data; write unit tests
learning_topics: Java fundamentals; object-oriented design; SQL; API design
project_ideas: Build a Java REST service; Create a library inventory API
entry_level_guidance: Build a tested service and learn a Java framework after core language concepts.

title: Data Analyst
description: Turn structured data into summaries and visual explanations that support decisions.
required_skills: SQL; spreadsheets; data cleaning; statistics; data visualization
interests: finding patterns; business questions; explaining data
typical_tasks: Query datasets; clean records; communicate findings
learning_topics: SQL; descriptive statistics; data cleaning; visualization
project_ideas: Analyze a public dataset; Create an interactive dashboard
entry_level_guidance: Practice asking clear questions and documenting data limitations.

title: Data Scientist
description: Use statistical analysis and machine learning methods to investigate data and build models.
required_skills: Python; statistics; SQL; pandas; machine learning basics
typical_tasks: Explore data; evaluate models; communicate uncertainty
learning_topics: Probability and statistics; Python data tools; model evaluation; data ethics
project_ideas: Compare simple classification models; Explore a dataset with a reproducible notebook
entry_level_guidance: Strengthen statistics and demonstrate careful evaluation on a small project.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Develop and integrate machine learning systems with attention to data, evaluation, and deployment.
required_skills: Python; machine learning; model evaluation; software engineering
related_skills: scikit-learn; APIs; data pipelines; cloud fundamentals
typical_tasks: Prepare data; train and evaluate models; integrate model services
learning_topics: Python; statistics; supervised learning; testing ML systems
project_ideas: Build a documented classification pipeline; Serve a simple model through an API
entry_level_guidance: Combine model fundamentals with software engineering practice.

title: NLP Engineer
description: Create software that processes text, such as search, classification, and information extraction tools.
required_skills: Python; text processing; machine learning basics; evaluation
interests: language; search; text analytics; machine learning
typical_tasks: Clean text; build retrieval or classification features; evaluate results
learning_topics: Text normalization; TF-IDF; information retrieval; model evaluation
project_ideas: Build a local document search tool; Compare text classification features
entry_level_guidance: Begin with interpretable text methods and evaluate errors with examples.

title: AI Engineer
description: Integrate AI techniques into useful software while considering reliability and user needs.
required_skills: Python; programming; data handling; model evaluation
related_skills: machine learning; APIs; product thinking; responsible AI
typical_tasks: Prototype AI-enabled features; test behavior; integrate software components
learning_topics: Programming; data and statistics foundations; machine learning concepts; responsible AI
project_ideas: Build a rule-based study helper; Create a local recommendation prototype
entry_level_guidance: AI work spans varied roles; build foundations gradually and choose a specialization.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Help identify, investigate, and reduce security risks in systems and information.
required_skills: Networking basics; operating systems; security fundamentals; analytical thinking
related_skills: Python; log analysis; cloud security; incident response
typical_tasks: Review alerts; investigate events; document defensive findings
learning_topics: Networking; operating systems; access control; security monitoring
project_ideas: Create a sample log analysis dashboard; Document a defensive security checklist
entry_level_guidance: Use legal practice environments and focus on defensive fundamentals.

title: Cloud Engineer
description: Design and operate cloud-based infrastructure and services with reliability and access controls in mind.
related_skills: Python; containers; identity and access; monitoring
typical_tasks: Configure services; monitor systems; manage access and resources
learning_topics: Linux; networking; cloud concepts; infrastructure as code
project_ideas: Deploy a small static site; Write an infrastructure diagram and runbook
entry_level_guidance: Learn concepts locally or with free learning materials; avoid unexpected paid resources.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Improve software delivery through automation, deployment practices, and system observability.
typical_tasks: Automate checks; support deployments; improve observability
learning_topics: Shell scripting; version control; CI/CD; containers; monitoring
project_ideas: Automate tests for a sample application; Create a local containerized service
entry_level_guidance: Practice repeatable local workflows and document operational decisions.

title: UI_UX_Designer
description: Research user needs and design understandable, accessible digital experiences.
required_skills: User research; wireframing; interaction design; accessibility
typical_tasks: Interview users; map journeys; prototype and test interfaces
learning_topics: Research methods; information architecture; accessibility; prototyping
project_ideas: Redesign a confusing form; Test a prototype with a small volunteer group
entry_level_guidance: Explain design choices and include feedback and accessibility considerations.

title: Product Manager
description: Coordinate product direction by connecting user needs, business context, and delivery teams.
required_skills: Communication; prioritization; user research; analytical thinking
typical_tasks: Clarify problems; prioritize work; align stakeholders
learning_topics: Product discovery; research; prioritization; outcome measurement
project_ideas: Write a product brief for a campus service; Map a user journey and trade-offs
entry_level_guidance: Practice evidence-based problem framing without assuming a single prescribed path.

title: QA and Software Tester
description: Check software behavior and help teams prevent, find, and clearly report defects.
required_skills: Test design; attention to detail; software fundamentals; communication
typical_tasks: Write test cases; reproduce issues; automate checks
learning_topics: Testing fundamentals; test planning; API testing; automation basics
project_ideas: Create a test plan for a sample app; Automate a form validation check
entry_level_guidance: Start with structured manual tests and progress toward automation.

title: Database Administrator
description: Maintain database reliability, access, performance, and recoverability.
required_skills: SQL; database fundamentals; backups; access control
typical_tasks: Manage database access; monitor performance; test recovery procedures
learning_topics: Relational modeling; SQL; transactions; backup and recovery
project_ideas: Design a database for a club; Write queries and a recovery checklist
entry_level_guidance: Practice with local database tools and understand safe data handling.

title: Business Analyst
description: Translate stakeholder needs into clear requirements and support process improvement.
required_skills: Requirements analysis; communication; process mapping; analytical thinking
typical_tasks: Interview stakeholders; document requirements; validate workflows
learning_topics: Requirements elicitation; process modeling; data literacy; acceptance criteria
project_ideas: Map a student-club registration process; Write sample user stories
entry_level_guidance: Show how assumptions were checked and how requirements connect to outcomes.

title: Mobile Application Developer
description: Create applications for mobile devices with attention to usability and device constraints.
interests: mobile products; user interfaces; practical tools
typical_tasks: Build screens; connect APIs; test on device sizes
learning_topics: Programming; mobile platform basics; interface design; API integration
project_ideas: Build a simple habit tracker; Create an offline-first notes prototype
entry_level_guidance: Choose one platform to start and build a small, usable application.

title: Technical Writer
description: Create clear technical documentation that helps people understand and use products.
required_skills: Writing; information organization; audience awareness; technical literacy
typical_tasks: Interview subject experts; write guides; review documentation
learning_topics: Audience analysis; information architecture; Markdown; editing
project_ideas: Write a setup guide for an open-source tool; Create a troubleshooting page
entry_level_guidance: Build samples that show clarity, accuracy, and reader-centered structure.
